title: kbingest.py map takes a group's mapper for a language, named as extension point ingest_mappers, and writes its symbols into the map as the shipped mappers do
goal: kbingest.py map calls the mapper extensions.ingest_mappers names for a language as mapper(repo_dir, rev, files) with the files whose suffix the mapper's SUFFIXES lists; the packages, imports, entry points and symbols it returns join the map under that language in the shipped record shapes; a group mapper wins over a shipped one for its language; a mapper that raises or answers another shape adds a note naming the language and the point and maps nothing for it

gates.question: How does kbingest.py load a group mapper named in extensions.ingest_mappers (an object, language to module:attr), since kbext.load takes one string setting per point?
gates.reason: it uses public names only (kbsettings.layered and layer_files, kbext.API_VERSION and BOUND_RE) with the KBEXT_REQUIRES rule of kbext, because kbext.py is outside the touches and another item changes it
gates.answer: a public loader in kbext.py, not a copy: kbext.py is now in this item's touches. ST-k2jjwnew (landing now) splits kbext.resolve into _find and _import and adds public load_all; after it lands, rebase onto origin/main and add one public kbext.load_spec(point, spec, root) that loads one module:attr with load's sys.path, KBEXT_REQUIRES and refusals (load_all may call it), then call it per language. Until the rebase, code against kbext.load_spec

gates.question: Which kept files does a group mapper receive: every file whose suffix its SUFFIXES lists, or only those no earlier language of the run maps?
options: every file with a listed suffix
gates.reason: a new language such as foo then never takes the shipped Python mapper's .py files, which the item's own check requires, while a group mapper that replaces a language still gets all of that language's files
